description: ClubMeister helps sports-team admins review schedules, RSVPs, attendance, members, venues, posts, polls, and team trends through ChatGPT. Admins can also create and update events, cancel events, set RSVPs, and publish team posts or polls. Each connection is limited to one team and every action is checked against the admin's current ClubMeister permissions.

defaultPrompt: Who is attending our next event, and who hasn’t responded?
How is my team doing lately? Show attendance and RSVP trends.
